THE SIGNATURE INGREDIENT

Caviar in every formula

Siberian sturgeon, Acipenser baerii

Rich in the lipids, amino acids and minerals skin relies on.

Origin
Sustainably farmed, fully traceable, never wild‑harvested.
Formulation
Micro‑encapsulated, so the extract keeps its potency and is released over time.

Why caviar

SWISS SCIENCE

Protect. Repair. Rejuvenate.
Protect.

Micro‑encapsulated caviar keeps its potency, while two antioxidants help defend skin against daily environmental stress.

Key actives:
Caviar extract ·
,
 Superoxide Dismutase ·
,
 Resveratrol

Repair.

Caviar lipids, close to the skin’s own, help replenish its barrier as hyaluronic acid holds moisture at three depths.

Key actives:
Caviar phospholipids ·
,
 Hyaluronic acid

Rejuvenate.

A peptide studied in collagen research joins caviar extract, for skin that looks firmer and smoother.

Key actives:
SYN®‑COLL peptide ·
,
 Caviar extract

Measured, formula by formula.

Separate 28‑day studies, each of a single formula, by an independent contract research organisation.

Advanced Repair Serum

Skin firmness

Read the studies

SWISS PROVENANCE

Fewer things, made well.

Precision is not a style here; it is how the work is done. Each formula is made in one place, patiently, and with care.

Our Swiss heritage
How we formulate in Zug

Zug, Switzerland
Where every formula is created and filled
20+ years
Making skincare in Zug
ISO 22716
Good manufacturing practice (GMP) for cosmetics
The Ritual

Always in this order, from the lightest texture to the richest.

CLEANSE
Step 1
: Cleanse.
Sweep a soaked cotton pad over face and neck to lift make‑up and the day’s impurities. No rinsing: the skin is ready for what follows.
(Micellar Water All-in-One Cleanser)
TREAT
Step 2
: Treat.
The most concentrated step. Press two or three drops into face and neck, then give them a minute to absorb.
(Advanced Repair Serum)
REVIVE
Step 3
: Revive.
Care for the thinnest skin of the face. Pat a little along the orbital bone, from the inner to the outer corner. Never drag.
(Revitalizing Eye Cream)
RESTORE
Step 4
: Restore.
The final step seals the ritual. Warm a pea‑sized amount between your palms and press it in, under SPF by day and overnight by night.
(24h Regeneration Cream)
Swiss skincare,
refined to the essential.
SHOP THE COMPLETE RITUAL
Free worldwide shipping
30-day returns
